'''Welleques''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was one of the leaders of the insurgents against the corrupt [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Crion]] on [[Telos IV]]. Welleques was not a righteous man and used dirty tactics such as killing Crion's daughter, [[Nason]]. Welleques was killed by [[Dairoki]], Nason's lover.
